prompts.bell: Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D game sprite animation sheet, transparent RGBA background. Reference image is existing Bellkeeper enemy identity and painted cartoon style. Preserve the SAME ivory clown face, red nose, violet eyes, crooked purple top hat with golden star, white gloves, brass engraved bell and purple spectral tail. Hand painted cohesive whole-body character in every cel, clean strong ink contours and subtle painted shading, spooky cartoon, not realism. No text, labels, grid lines, backgrounds or floor shadows. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and EIGHT ROWS, 32 evenly spaced complete full-body cels, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Portrait sheet 1024x2048. Each cell square256; keep character inside 224x224, centred, bottom at same baseline. Consistent body dimensions and camera, facing left in three-quarter side view. Distinct smooth sequential animation drawings, no detached joint puppet pieces, no cropping or touching neighbouring cells. Retain intact bronze BELL SHELL in all32frames. Frames0-7 (rows1-2): smooth eight-pose floating loop, bell body gently leans left then right with visible swinging golden clapper, gloves and purple tail follow weight. Frames8-15(rows3-4): eight-pose bell-ringing action: gather hands and lean back, lift bell lip, exaggerated swing to left, clapper strikes inside rim, recoil right, counter-swing, settle; small purple resonance strokes confined to cells. Frames16-19(row5): four-pose anticipation lifting the heavy bell up to slam. Frames20-23(row6): four-pose bell slammed down and compressed then recoiling, white gloves gripping rim. Frames24-27(row7): four-pose summoning, slowly raising gloves and drawing pale blue tiny spirit glow above palms. Frames28-31(row8): four-pose exhausted recovery, droopy face and gloves, clapper exposed. The bell is always substantial golden bronze, hollow underneath, smoothly hand animated with weight. Every face and costume must stay on model.

prompts.break: Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D game transformation sprite sheet, exactly4columns and3rows, 12 full-body sequential cels. True transparent background, no text, grid lines or scenery. Image1 shows the BRASS BELL form of the Bellkeeper, image2 shows the SAME clown as a sinister spectral second form. Animate the bell breaking to reveal that exact second form. Same left-facing three-quarter orientation throughout, SAME ivory face/red nose/purple star top hat/white gloves, same face dimensions and body scale every cel. Hand painted cartoon with crisp ink outline matching reference. Character fully contained within each cell with generous gutters. Row1 frames0-3: intact bell tense, first bright hairline fractures, larger cracks, shell bulging under violet internal light. Row2 frames4-7: bell splits at lip, brass plates fall downward and outward, spectral indigo collar and arms revealed, last brass plates and golden clapper fall clear. Row3 frames8-11: newly freed ghost stretches upright, menacing grin replaces startled face, ghost tail gathers into blue-violet curl, settles into exact first idle pose of second reference. No legs/feet or gore. Debris size diminishes and drops to lower cell edge in late frames. The spectral tail remains at the same baseline while the face holds the same size. 1536x1152 landscape sheet, all twelve distinct complete poses equal spatial registration.
